About this snapshot

Captured November 9, 2026 at 07:49:30 UTC (02:49:30 EST). Phase: finished. Voting: closed.

Each judge awards 1-5 points for the answer and 1-5 for handling the heat: up to 10 points per player per round, or 100 per judge across the game. Heat scores measure the player's response, not the sauce's spiciness.

Roster history from the original report: terry was withdrawn at November 8, 2026, 18:13:11 UTC. Their scores are not included in these results.

All 100 recorded submissions match the supplied manifest and CSV; totals are Daniel 789 and Joicee 890. Validation rooms, session tokens, and member IDs are excluded. This archive is not connected to the live game.
